calls `00249210` with the incoming register arguments and a fifth (stack) argument 0, stores `00249660` at `+0x10` of the returned object and returns that object's qword `+0x8`

switches on the dword at `rdx`: other values return `005C5230(rcx)`; 18 returns 0; 12 zeroes qword `+0xF0` of `rcx` and returns 0; 1 stores dword 0 at `+0x98` and the values of dwords `01E0C1D8` and `01E0C1DC` as words at `+0x9C` and `+0x9E` (only when `rcx` is non-null), zeroes byte `+0xC8`, dword `+0xEC`, word `+0xC0` and dword `+0xC4`, calls `00247930(rcx, 0xDC)` and `00247950(rcx, 1)` and returns 0; 4 acts only when the word `+0xC0` is 2 to 5: it stores `00861F0E(dword 0208F570 * 3.141593 / 30) * 32 + 96` as bytes `+0x91` and `+0x92` and also `+0x90` (0x80 instead when the word is 3) of the object at qword `+0x38`, and, when `002EA230(dword +0xEC)` is zero, gets a position with `002E9A90` and `00249110(.., 02AEDDB0, .., 1)`, returns 0 when its third dword is at least 0x1000000, clamps that dword to 0x100000 to 0x400000, forms the scale `(value - 0x100000) * 0.5 / 3145728 + 0.5`, calls `002B3400(&record, rcx+0xC8, 0)` and draws with `002D8650(object at +0x38, x - scaled word +0xE8 / 2, y - scaled word +0xEA, &record)`; all these paths return 0

notes: 001B1C10: the length loop that sizes the 0019C5D0 call never reloads the byte (it tests the first byte only), so the size is 1 or 0x100 exactly as stated; 008C2A40 (copy) and 008C3020 (per-byte transform) are import slots, not decoded further. The stored pointer is qword +0x60, advanced by dword +0x38 of the +0x50 object while it equals a pointer walked from qword +0x10, plus dword +0xF8; the row abbreviates this. The final 00249110 call writes three dwords x, y, z into a stack record; z is the clamped one. 0035C160: the case-12 store is not anchored (five-anchor limit); it is the mov at 0035C160+0x51. The scale is also stored into the 002B3400 record at +0x34 before the 002D8650 call.
